residual_risk: This verdict covers only the staged instrument amendment and recovery controller, using deterministic fake native phases plus owned process/loopback tests. It is not an audit or acceptance of either ServiceFlow app. Live benchmark roots, native sessions and private snapshots were not inspected or changed; real recovery installation and future native behavior remain primary integration work. Explicit file scope and baseline hashes replace unavailable Git history. Formatter native probe is retained external evidence and was not rerun. Existing README preflight includes an extraneous trailing dot for the Contracts selector; the six actual Contracts were run successfully without that selector. No production security certification or exhaustive vulnerability claim.
